html.examiner_please_keep_the_3_meter_lo.source: Examiner, please keep the 3-meter-long athletic tape line from the Timed Gait on the floor/firm surface. html.examiner_read_the_following_numbers.source: Examiner, read the following numbers (one sequence from each set) and ask the athlete to repeat them back in reverse order. Say them slowly at a rate of one digit per second. Each set has two number sequences. If the athlete fails the first, try the second. If both fail, end this subsection and move on to the months in reverse order.
html.examiner_read_the_following_numbers.value: Ondersoeker: lees die volgende syfers (een reeks uit elke stel) en vra die atleet om dit in omgekeerde volgorde te herhaal. Sê dit stadig teen een syfer per sekonde. Elke stel het twee reekse. Probeer die tweede as die atleet die eerste nie slaag nie. Indien albei misluk, beëindig hierdie onderafdeling en gaan na die maande in omgekeerde volgorde.

You'll need a spotter to keep an eye on the athlete and be ready to assist them if they become unstable and begin to fall.

html.healthy_athletes_typically_complete.source: Healthy athletes typically complete the task in 18.7-22.5 seconds with 85.8-92.4% accuracy (0.9-1.7 errors). Concussed athletes typically take 30.6-36.1 seconds with 76.4-83.6% accuracy (2.0-2.8 errors).

html.healthy_athletes_typically_have_a_f.source: Healthy athletes typically have a fastest time between 13.9 and 15.8. Newly concussed athletes are typically between 21.9 and 26.1. Athletes concussed within the last 6-73 days will be somewhere in between.
html.healthy_athletes_typically_have_a_f.value: Gesonde atlete se vinnigste tyd is gewoonlik tussen 13,9 en 15,8 sekondes. Atlete met 'n onlangse harsingskudding is gewoonlik tussen 21,9 en 26,1 sekondes. Atlete wat binne die afgelope 6–73 dae harsingskudding opgedoen het, sal êrens tussenin wees.
